name: SkillsBench
intro: SkillsBench 是一个评估 Agent Skills 实际增益的基准，使用跨领域任务、专家整理的 Skills 和确定性验证器来衡量技能包对代理完成任务的帮助程度。
org: BenchFlow, Ohio State University, Amazon, Dartmouth College, Stanford University, UC Davis, Carnegie Mellon University, UC Berkeley, and collaborators
build_method: 专家任务构建, 技能包整理, 确定性验证器
eval_feature: 技能使用, 确定性验证, 全轨迹记录
intro_en: SkillsBench benchmarks whether agent skills actually improve task completion. It pairs cross-domain tasks with curated skills and deterministic verifiers, and evaluates no-skill, curated-skill, and self-generated-skill settings.
build_method_en: Expert task construction, skill-package curation, deterministic verifiers
eval_feature_en: Skill Usage, Deterministic Verification, Full Trajectory Logging
flowchart_zh:
flowchart LR
    A["先在 11 个领域中设计可复现的 agent 任务"] --> B["为每个任务配套专家整理的 Skills 与确定性验证器"]
    B --> C["把任务分成无 Skills、人工 Skills、自生成 Skills 三种条件"]
    C --> D["在统一 agent harness 中运行 7 组 agent-model 配置"]
    D --> E["记录每次尝试的完整执行轨迹"]
    E --> F["用确定性验证器判定任务是否完成"]
    F --> G["按任务、领域与模型汇总 pass rate"]
    G --> H["比较 curated Skills 与 self-generated Skills 的增益差异"]
flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["Design reproducible agent tasks across 11 domains"] --> B["Pair each task with curated skills and deterministic verifiers"]
    B --> C["Evaluate every task under no-skill, curated-skill, and self-generated-skill settings"]
    C --> D["Run seven agent-model configurations inside a unified harness"]
    D --> E["Log the full execution trajectory of every attempt"]
    E --> F["Use deterministic verifiers to decide task success"]
    F --> G["Aggregate pass rates by task, domain, and model"]
    G --> H["Compare the gains from curated skills versus self-generated skills"]
